# M2-6: turn the bank import on in the hoid deploy

- Milestone: M2
- Branch / worktree: `t/M2-6`, `../YNAB_AutoCategorizer.wt/M2-6`
- Depends on: M2-5 (merged, cut over 2026-11-08)
- Touches (exclusive while running): `deploy/` (compose.yaml and any deploy tests or rehearsal fixtures that pin the value)
- Plan refs: BA-13 in docs/build/STATE.md (Brendan, 2026-11-08: "turn on after the cutover, as a deploy change")
- YNAB access: none. Never call the import POST against the live plan from tests or by hand; sup's deploy turns it on.
- Deploy: yes (steps below)

## Goal
Brendan approved `IMPORT_ENABLED` on the live plan. Today `deploy/compose.yaml` forces it to `"false"`. After this task
the hoid deploy runs the import job every `IMPORT_INTERVAL` (default 6h), with nothing else about the deploy changed.

## Scope
- `deploy/compose.yaml`: `IMPORT_ENABLED: "true"`. Keep it pinned in compose (not forwarded from `.env`), so the live value
  is visible in the repo and a local `.env` can't change it.
- Update anything under `deploy/` (tests, rehearsal fixtures, comments) that asserts or documents the old `false`.
- Confirm by reading `cmd/` (don't change it) when the first import fires after a restart (immediately, or one interval
  later) and how a failed or rate-budget-refused import is logged. Put the answer in your Result, so sup's smoke check
  knows what to look for.

## Out of scope
- Any change to `cmd/`, `sync/`, `ynab/` or `config/`. If the import job looks wrong, report it under Result; don't fix it.
- CLAUDE.md and docs/plan/*: list the needed wording changes (CLAUDE.md's Build & Run deploy paragraph and Safety section)
  under "Docs follow-ups".
- Running `deploy.sh`, `cutover.sh` or anything against hoid.

## Acceptance (each must be demonstrably checked)
- [ ] `grep -rn IMPORT_ENABLED deploy/` shows only the new `"true"` value (or comments that agree with it)
- [ ] Any deploy test or rehearsal script in `deploy/` passes (name the commands you ran)
- [ ] go build ./... && go vet ./... && go test ./... green
- [ ] Result says when the first import fires after a restart and which log lines show success, skip and failure

## Deploy steps / smoke check (only if Deploy: yes)
1. After merge and push: `./deploy/deploy.sh` from the main checkout (the tunnel-active marker exists, so cloudflared
   stays up). Confirm `curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -X POST https://finance.hoidlabs.site/mcp` is 401 afterwards.
2. `ssh hoid 'docker exec finbot-finbot-1 env | grep -c "^IMPORT_ENABLED=true$"'` → 1.
3. Once the first import is due (per the Result), check the finbot logs for the success line and no error. Grep the
   output for UUIDs and tokens before showing any of it.

## Result
- Status: DONE
- What changed:
  - `deploy/compose.yaml`: `IMPORT_ENABLED: "true"`, still pinned in compose. That line is the only code change.
  - Nothing else under `deploy/` asserted or documented the old value, so no tests, fixtures or comments needed updating.
- Acceptance:
  - `grep -rn IMPORT_ENABLED deploy/` → pass: one hit, `deploy/compose.yaml:20: IMPORT_ENABLED: "true"`.
  - Deploy rehearsals → pass: `./deploy/rehearse.sh` (passed=169 failed=0), `./deploy/rehearse-docker.sh` (passed=22 failed=0).
    Neither one reaches the import: the fake hoid doesn't run finbot, and the docker run ends long before the 6h tick. They
    show the deploy still works with the new value, not that an import succeeds.
  - Pin holds → pass: `docker compose config` with an env file containing `IMPORT_ENABLED=false` still resolves to `"true"`.
    `deploy.sh` doesn't forward the key either.
  - `go build ./... && go vet ./... && go test ./...` → pass, all packages ok.
  - First import timing and log lines → below (from reading `cmd/scheduler.go`, `cmd/app.go`, `sync/sync.go`; not run live).
- First import after a restart: **one full `IMPORT_INTERVAL` later (6h on hoid), never immediately.** `Scheduler.Run` starts a
  plain in-memory `time.NewTicker`, and only sync runs at startup. Nothing persists the timer, so **every restart or deploy
  resets the 6h clock**: count from the container's latest start (`docker inspect -f '{{.State.StartedAt}}' finbot-finbot-1`).
- Log lines (slog JSON on the container's stdout; match on `msg`):

  | When | Level | `msg` | Fields |
  |---|---|---|---|
  | Startup | INFO | `import enabled` | `interval` = `6h0m0s` (right after the deploy; `import disabled` means the flag is off) |
  | Success | INFO | `sync: import created N transactions`, then `import tick` | `imported`=N, `skipped`=false |
  | Skip (local budget refused, or YNAB 429) | INFO | `sync: skipping import: <reason>`, then `import tick` | `imported`=0, `skipped`=true |
  | Failure (anything else) | ERROR | `import tick failed` | `err` (redacted) |

  - `imported`=0 with `skipped`=false is a success: YNAB had nothing new.
  - A skip is INFO and is not retried; the next try is the next tick. So the smoke check must read `skipped`, not just look
    for `import tick` and the absence of ERROR.
  - The Slack status message should read `*Import:* on` after the deploy (it reads `cfg.ImportEnabled`), so it's a second
    way to confirm the flag.
- Deviations from brief: none.
- Follow-ups for backlog (reported, not changed; none block this deploy):
  - Import outcomes are only logged. A failing import doesn't touch `/healthz`, the dead-man ping or the Slack message, so
    repeated failures stay silent unless someone reads the logs.
  - Because the timer resets on restart, a run of deploys less than 6h apart postpones the import each time.
- Docs follow-ups:
  - CLAUDE.md, Build & Run deploy paragraph: "which sets `TZ=America/Denver` and `IMPORT_ENABLED=false`" → `IMPORT_ENABLED=true`.
  - CLAUDE.md, Safety: replace "`IMPORT_ENABLED` defaults to false; turning it on against the live plan needs Brendan's OK."
    with: the config default stays false, the hoid deploy pins it true in `deploy/compose.yaml` (Brendan approved, BA-13,
    2026-11-08), so that deploy POSTs to the live plan every `IMPORT_INTERVAL`. Turning it on anywhere else against the
    live plan still needs Brendan's OK.
